# `c_0603_{loaded,refreshed}_*.ipc.bin`

Six `kiapi.board.types.FootprintInstance` messages, serialised exactly as
KiCad's IPC API sent them, for the stock `Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric`
(the same footprint as `c_0603_1608metric_kicad10.kicad_mod`).

`pcb_footprint_update`'s tests decode them for #970. Before that fix,
`update_footprints_from_library` planned `pads`, `graphics` and `metadata` for
every one of them, though none differs from the library.

## Provenance

| | |
|---|---|
| KiCad | 10.0.6 (Fedora 44 `kicad-10.0.6-1.fc44`), pcbnew under a headless Weston |
| Source board | A scratch 2-layer board made with pcbnew Python: `FootprintLoad` of the stock library, `SetFPID`, `SetOrientationDegrees`, `Flip` for the back side, `SaveBoard` |
| Transport | `GetItems` over the running editor's IPC socket, as `update_footprints_from_library` reads it |
| Captured | 2026-10-24 |

| File | Placement | State |
|------|-----------|-------|
| `c_0603_loaded_front_0.ipc.bin` | F.Cu, 0° | as KiCad placed it from the library |
| `c_0603_loaded_front_180.ipc.bin` | F.Cu, 180° | as KiCad placed it from the library |
| `c_0603_loaded_back_90.ipc.bin` | B.Cu, 90° | as KiCad placed it from the library |
| `c_0603_refreshed_front_0.ipc.bin` | F.Cu, 0° | after this tool refreshed it (one `fp_line` had been removed) |
| `c_0603_refreshed_front_180.ipc.bin` | F.Cu, 180° | likewise |
| `c_0603_refreshed_back_90.ipc.bin` | B.Cu, 90° | likewise |

The `refreshed_` captures were read back from KiCad after an apply with the
#970 fix, so they record what KiCad stores for what the builder sends. KiCad
saved those three footprints identical to the `loaded_` ones, UUIDs aside.

## What KiCad reports that the builder does not send

All of these are representation, not content, and the planner now compares
past them:

- every pad, shape, text and field text names the footprint as its `parent`;
- an SMD pad's absent hole is a zero-size drill from `F.Cu` to `B.Cu`;
- a roundrect pad carries `chamfer_ratio` 0.2 and a `custom_anchor_shape`,
  which KiCad saves only for chamfered and custom pads;
- a pad on the back reports 270° where the builder sends −90°;
- a `(type default)` stroke reads as `SLS_SOLID`, so default and solid cannot
  be told apart on a read.

Two more the builder now sends as KiCad keeps them: a rotated rectangle's
corners in rotated order, and a text's angle as placed (180°, not turned
upright).

## Redaction

Nothing was removed. The messages contain only the stock library's strings
(`Capacitor_SMD`, its description, `KiLib_Generator`, the
`${KICAD10_3DMODEL_DIR}` model path), the field names, the value `100n`,
protobuf type URLs and KIIDs. They hold no board path, username or hostname.

## Regenerating them

There is no capture test. Load a board as above in pcbnew with the API
enabled, and write `FootprintInstance::encode_to_vec()` for each instance
`build_updated_instance` receives. For the `refreshed_` files,
remove one `fp_line` from each footprint in the saved board, apply the
refresh, and capture on the next dry run.
